criteria.note: idem_reserve(): atomic idempotency reservation inside one BEGIN IMMEDIATE sqlite transaction — a duplicate key reads the winner's resp_id instead of executing again; fail-closed (sqlite errors propagate). This is the ControlStore.idem_reserve method wq#1807 adds in despag/backing/control_sqlite.py (new file, ~285 ln) alongside lease_admit/lease_renew/lease_release/lease_still_held (per-session lease with monotonic fence, despag/backing/control_sqlite.py:155-255) and resp_put_running/resp_mark_terminal/resp_get (one-way terminal latch, despag/backing/control_sqlite.py:257-305). The four Protocol interfaces (GraphStore/BlobStore/SecretStore/WorkspaceFiles) + Backing composition + local impls (SqliteGraphStore/FileBlobStore/FileSecretStore/LocalWorkspaceFiles) + make_backing() live in despag/backing/__init__.py (new file, 382 ln). despag/app.py wires Idempotency-Key + the session lease into POST /v1/responses: _idem_admit (despag/app.py:231-249) reserves/replays/waits on the Idempotency-Key header; create_response (despag/app.py:252-307) admits metadata.session_id/previous_response_id through CONTROL.lease_admit(reject_on_conflict=True) and returns 409 session_busy on an active conflict (despag/app.py:286-296).
